subject: Request: cohort trial extension + credit allocation for SparkBridge Labs
messages:
From: Carmen Diaz <ops@sparkbridge.vc>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: 2024-08-22T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Request: cohort trial extension + demo credits

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the founders who attended were impressed by the latency profiles and the cost controls. We're kicking off our summer cohort (10 teams) and have a procurement window that closes next Wednesday. Two asks from my side: 1) a 60-day trial extension for each team (we'd like to run heavier end-to-end tests), and 2) a package of usage credits to run demo workloads (we estimate ~40k tokens per team over the period).

If Redwood can support this, we'll commit to a short conversion check-in post-cohort and share usage telemetry. I can send a mutual action plan if that helps speed procurement.

Appreciate any flexibility — we prefer to keep this in the accelerator budget rather than individual startups having to do card-based trials.

Best,
Carmen
Program Ops, SparkBridge Labs
attachments: SparkBridge_MutualActionPlan.xlsx
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Carmen Diaz <ops@sparkbridge.vc>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2024-08-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: cohort trial extension + demo credits

Carmen — thanks for the note and congrats on the cohort kickoff. Happy to explore this. Quick proposal from our side: 60-day extension + a shared pool of 350k tokens allocated to the cohort (that averages to 35k/team) and a dedicated sandbox workspace with preloaded evals.

Two asks from our side to get approvals fast:
- Marissa: can you sign off on an exception for the shared pool (standard accelerator playbook is 25k/team) and confirm any legal/finance gating?
- Dev: can you provision a sandbox workspace and a one-hour onboarding demo for cohort engineers next Tuesday?

If that sounds reasonable, Carmen, I'll attach a short mutual action plan and pilot terms and loop in finance for the final stamp.

Thanks,
Sean
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Putting this on record: conditional approval from Growth credits for SparkBridge cohort. Approve 350k token pool for 60 days under the following conditions:
- Signed mutual action plan (basic MOU) that includes a post-cohort conversion review and high-level usage telemetry sharing.
- Pilot terms signed by SparkBridge (I attached pilot_terms_v1.pdf).
- Deal ID SB-20240822-01 created in HubSpot; finance will require the HubSpot deal before credits are drawn.

Notes on limits and telemetry: we'll provision the cohort namespace with rate-limited keys to prevent accidental runaway consumption; if teams need higher caps we can escalate per-team.

Putting a calendar invite for the cohort demo (attached).
